title: MuQ-Eval: An Open-Source Per-Sample Quality Metric for AI Music Generation Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2603.22677v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distributional metrics such as Fr\'echet Audio Distance cannot score individual music clips and correlate poorly with human judgments, while the only per-sample learned metric achieving high human correlation is closed-source. We introduce MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AIgenerated music built by training lightweight prediction heads on frozen MuQ-310M features using MusicEval, a dataset of generated clips from 31 text-to-music systems with expert quality ratings. Our simplest model, frozen features with attention pooling and a two-layer MLP, achieves system-level SRCC = 0.957 and utterance-level SRCC = 0.838 with human mean opinion scores. A systematic ablation over training objectives and adaptation strategies shows that no addition meaningfully improves the frozen baseline, indicating that frozen MuQ representations already capture quality-relevant information. translated_title: MuQ-Eval：一个用于AI音乐生成评估的开源逐样本质量指标
translated_abstract: 诸如Fréchet音频距离（FAD）等分布性指标无法对单个音乐片段进行评分，且与人类判断的相关性较差，而唯一实现高人类相关性的逐样本学习型指标却是闭源的。我们提出了MUQ-EVAL，一个用于AI生成音乐的开源逐样本质量指标。该指标通过在冻结的MuQ-310M特征上训练轻量级预测头构建而成，训练数据来自MusicEval数据集——该数据集包含由31个文本到音乐系统生成的片段及专家质量评分。我们最简单的模型（冻结特征配合注意力池化和两层MLP）在与人类平均意见分数的对比中达到了系统级SRCC = 0.957和语句级SRCC = 0.838。对训练目标和适配策略进行的系统性消融实验表明，没有任何附加组件能显著改进冻结基线，这说明冻结的MuQ表征本身已经捕获了与质量相关的信息。编码器的选择是主导性的设计因素。
tldr: 提出了开源的逐样本AI音乐质量评估指标MuQ-Eval，通过在冻结的MuQ特征上训练轻量预测头，实现了与人类评分的高度相关性（系统级SRCC达0.957），填补了高质量评估指标闭源的空白。
